title: Narrative OS State Document
description: The single source of truth for a story session.

story_id.description: Unique identifier for the story session.

chapter.description: Current chapter number (0 = not yet started).

characters.description: Map of character key (e.g., 'harry') to character record.

relationships.description: Map of relationship pair key (e.g., 'harry_hermione') to relationship record.

event_ledger.description: Chronological list of all significant story events.

promises.description: All unresolved and recently resolved plot promises.

locations.description: Map of location name to location record.

chapters_written.description: Full prose text of each completed chapter, in order.

genre_profile.description: Configuration that tailors prompts and behavior for the story's genre.

event.description: A significant story event with causal links.

promise.description: An unresolved plot thread promised to the reader.

ripple.description: A delayed consequence scheduled to trigger later.

location.description: A significant place in the story world.

memory_pack.description: Compressed snapshot of state used for context.
